questions.stem: While doing hysterectomy after informed consent for uterine fibroids, the ureter is injured intraoperatively even after careful measures. Doctor is not responsible under which doctrine:
questions.solutionHtml:
Medical mal occurrence

As the doctor took the best measures, and still the ureter was injured, he is not responsible under doctrine of medical maloccurrence.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 39.

questions.stem: A patient comes to casualty with life threatening injuries. There was no time for consent and Dr. started life saving surgery with all precaution. Death of a Patient occurred. Doctor is not responsible under which doctrine?
questions.solutionHtml:
Doctrine of anticipation

Life saving surgery done in an emergency without consent is not an offence.

Doctor is not responsible under the Doctrine of anticipation .



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number-53.

questions.stem: A 14 year old girl comes to AIIMS emergency OPD with her mother. History of Peno-vaginal penetration by a neighbor was told to the doctor. In addition the patient refused to consent for a medical examination. What will you do as a doctor?Should not call policeShould counsel mother and daughterShould call policeShould do examination even after refusedInformed refused to be documentedSelect the Answer from the code given below:2
questions.solutionHtml:
2, 3 ,5 are true
  • As it’s a medico legal case, informing the police is compulsory.(Statement 3).
  • Mother and daughter should be counselled.(Statement 2).
  • Consent is necessary before physical examination. As the age is 14 years, the child’s consent is a must as per 89 IPC.
  • The patient’s choice of not giving consent must be taken in written form in the front of two witnesses. And the doctor must not forcefully do the examination. (Statement 5)


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 416-425.

questions.stem: Which of the following is false about snake bite management?

options.label: A
options.text: ASV is the mainstay of treatment

options.label: B
options.text: Humped pit viper in not include in polyvalent ASV in India

options.label: C
options.text: Neostigmine, Ventilator support should be given to patients along with ASV.

options.label: D
options.text: Neostigmine , atropine may be given for krait bite.

questions.answerText: Neostigmine , atropine may be given for krait bite.
questions.solutionHtml:
Neostigmine , atropine may be given for krait bite.

Neostigmine is an anticholinesterase that prolongs the life of acetylcholine and can therefore reverse respiratory failure and neurotoxic symptoms. It is particularly effective for postsynaptic neurotoxins such as those of the Cobra.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 564,565.

questions.stem: Minimum punishment for death of patient by spurious drug:
questions.solutionHtml:
Life imprisonment

Minimum punishment for death of a patient by spurious drugs is Life imprisonment.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 27,28.

questions.stemHtml: Identify the type of skull fracture as shown in Image :
questions.solutionHtml:
Linear

Image is of an infant skull showing a skull fracture which looks like a line on the outer table of the skull called a linear or fissured fracture.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 243.

questions.stemHtml: Identify the injury shown in injury:
questions.solutionHtml:
Incised wound

As the wound is with clean cut margin,elliptical shape and length > depth are typical for Incised wound.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 192.
